title: Fix install.ps1: missing lib/, shallow templates copy, dir-exists detection
description: Three bugs in install.ps1 prevent the new sprint-1/2/3 features from reaching installed copies. (1) lib/ directory is never copied; scripts that import from ../lib/shard-library.mjs etc. crash at module load. (2) Copy-Item with templates wildcard does shallow copy; subdirectory templates/living-docs/ (5 files) never installed; init-project.mjs cannot scaffold living docs. (3) Lines 18-26: if skillDst exists AND not Force, entire skill copy is skipped; operator runs install, sees no error, assumes everything updated. Verify by diffing installed dir vs source dir post-install.
acceptance_criteria: install.ps1 copies lib/*.mjs to skillDst/lib/ (creates dir if absent)
install.ps1 copies templates/ recursively so templates/living-docs/*.md lands in skillDst/templates/living-docs/
Install always copies skill files even when skillDst exists. Drop the not-Force skip or replace with per-file overwrite. Default behavior is always-overwrite for skill-owned files.

After running install.ps1 -Force, recursive diff of C:/Coding/ai_dev/orchestrator/skill vs C:/Users/v-jessemeyer/.config/opencode/skills/orchestrator reports zero differences excluding .git and node_modules
install.ps1 prints a final summary line listing counts of scripts, lib files, templates, commands installed
README.md install section reflects new behavior if it exists; skip this AC if no install section exists in README
